intro: Design and development of the digital experience for Oky, a platform offering personalized financial services for migrant communities, and its B2B counterpart, Oky Business. The challenge was to create a cohesive visual identity for both audiences, integrating clarity, trust, and scalability across the experience. We worked on information architecture, navigation, and brand tone to reflect Oky’s values of inclusion and accessible technology. The user-facing site focuses on a clean, modern, and friendly interface, while Oky Business strengthens institutional messaging and highlights benefits for corporate partners.
media: Designing a seamless, high-trust digital experience for Oky
